_why: Known, accepted exceptions on pages that shipped before this gate existed. The gate fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file only ever shrinks. Never regenerate it to make a build pass: add an entry with a reason, or fix the page.

index.html._literals_why: The heading 'Where the cost goes - Singapore to the Philippines, S$5,000' names the rung that section always draws. It labels a fixed choice rather than reporting a measurement, but it is still a number in the markup: worth binding to the value the chart is drawn from.
index.html._errors_why_braces: index.html is rendered by a small templating runtime. Between parse and substitution the raw {{ ... }} text sits briefly in SVG geometry attributes and the browser logs a parse error for each before the runtime replaces it. Cosmetic, on every load, and worth removing by setting those attributes from script instead of markup.
index.html._errors_why_fee_tiers: data/fee_tiers.csv is fetched through opt() and does not exist yet. The chart renders an explicit empty state saying so, which is the 'gaps stay gaps' rule working as intended. The 404 disappears when the fee-tier collector lands; this entry should be deleted then.

corridor.html._errors_why: New sidecar (collector.py's append_waterfall) that the current samples.csv rows have no matching entry for yet -- it only exists from the next real collection pass onward, 'never backfill'. The waterfall renders an explicit 'not available yet' state for that sample rather than the old, non-reconciling approximation. The 404 disappears on its own once collection has run at least once past this change; this entry should be deleted then.
corridor.html._errors_why_depth: SEB-181's new per-size remaining-depth sidecar (collector.py's append_depth_sidecar) -- same shape as corridor_waterfall.csv above: it only exists from the next real collection pass onward. renderDepth() just omits the per-size sentence when the sidecar has no row for this exact sample yet, never an invented number. The 404 disappears on its own once collection has run at least once past this change; this entry should be deleted then.

how-it-was-built.html._errors_why: SEB-174/M2. tools/emit_machine_room_meters.py is a new collect.yml step; data/machine_room_meters.json does not exist until that workflow runs once past this merge -- 'never backfill'. The three tiles it feeds keep their seeded '—' on this 404 rather than showing a fabricated number. Disappears on its own after the next successful collect.yml run; delete this entry then.

status.html._errors_why: status.html is a retired redirect stub (0-second meta-refresh) to how-it-was-built.html -- the client-side redirect fires inside this check's settle window, so how-it-was-built.html's own pending 404 (see that page's entry above) gets logged against this page name instead. Same cause, same fix timeline: delete once collect.yml has written data/machine_room_meters.json at least once.

data.html._errors_why: data.html is a retired redirect stub (0-second meta-refresh) to how-it-was-built.html -- same bleed as status.html's entry above, same fix timeline.
